overview: Personal watchlists, shared viewing progress and smarter deletion warnings.
description: Keep track of what you want to watch and see what others on your server are watching. WatchGuard adds personal watchlists, shared viewing progress and warnings before you delete something someone still wants to watch. Optional server-side protection can also block supported Jellyfin deletions until an administrator approves them.
